segments.text: When people tell you to eat healthy,
what do they usually tell you to eat?
Fruits and vegetables, right?
Which totally, but what I find interesting
is when the University of Michigan looked at 5,800 foods
to see how many minutes they add or take away
from your life based on various factors,
while fruits and vegetables did well,
there was one category that did significantly better
than all the others.
And unfortunately, I see it demonized quite frequently.
What's another food that's deemed healthy
but absolutely is not healthy?
Nut butters.
Yup, nuts and or seeds.
And for all of you about to say peanuts aren't a nut,
I would like to present to you technically all berries.
There is botanical and then culinary definitions.
Please learn the difference.
Seriously though, they have so many amazing things
for your health, but because they're high calorie,
people think they're unhealthy.
Fun fact, low calorie and healthy aren't the same thing.
Out of 10.
Okay, bye.
